title.zh: Kalshi, Coinbase stock perps under threat ahead of CFTC deadline

current_state.zh: A lawsuit by the Capital Markets Alliance against the CFTC has put Kalshi's and Coinbase's stock perpetual futures at risk, with the CFTC facing a deadline to defend its authority to approve such products.
